result.title: BUMP: Body-driven Unified Multi-object Physics for HOI Synthesis
result.summary: Generating human-object interactions (HOIs) with multiple objects is challenging because the resulting motions arise from different underlying causes. Human motion reflects semantic intent, intentionally manipulated objects must remain coordinated with the human, while surrounding objects move primarily as physical consequences of contact and collision. We present BUMP, a text-driven framework for multi-object HOI generation based on a simple principle: learn intentional motion and simulate physical consequences. Our method first generates full-body human motion from text and scene context, then predicts trajectories for a small number of intentionally manipulated driver objects conditioned on the human motion. We then obtain responder object motions through physics simulation, allowing the framework to handle varying numbers and configurations of surrounding objects without expanding the learned trajectory output space. To address the scarcity of paired full-body multi-object HOI data, we combine heterogeneous supervision from human-only motion, full-body HOI, and hand-centric manipulation data augmented with plausible body motion. We further introduce outcome-conditioned interaction editing, which infers a local modification of the causal driver object trajectory from a desired responder object behavior without requiring an explicit target driver object trajectory. Experiments demonstrate strong performance on both single-object and multi-object HOI benchmarks. Qualitative results showcase diverse scenarios involving inter-object relationships and edits, highlighting the advantage of our unified model formulation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 BUMP，一个文本驱动的多物体人物交互生成框架：先由文本与场景上下文生成全身人体动作，再预测少数被有意操作的「驱动」物体轨迹，其余物体的运动交由物理仿真产生，并结合人体动作、全身交互与手部操作等异构数据监督，还引入结果条件化的交互编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其把运动分解为「学习到的有意驱动变量＋仿真得到的结果变量」，以及由期望结果反推驱动轨迹的编辑方式，可能为 latent 推理中的因果贡献分配与从答案逆向推断内部状态提供概念线索，可供核查。
